text.en:
The Sitio of Paloyon Oriental in Barangay Paloyon, Municipality of Nabua, Province of
Camarines Sur, is hereby converted into a distinct and independent barangay of the said municipality, to be
known as Barangay Paloyon Oriental.

Barangay Paloyon Oriental shall consist of the territory included within the following
boundaries:
"From the boundary line between the Municipalities of Nabua and Bato, being at point 1 of Lot 6827, PLS
1053-D on the plan (Lot 6827, PLS 1053-D being owned by Juan Sumayo), thence to points 2-3-4-5-6 on plan
of Lot 6827-PLS 1053-D, thence to points 26-27 on plan of Lot 6827-PLS 1053-D, thence to points 31-32 and
33 on plan PLS 1053-D, thence to point 10 on plan of Lot 6774, thence to point 3 on plan of Lot 6773, thence
to points 3-2-1 on plan of Lot 6770, thence to points 4-5 on plan of Lot 6767, thence to points 6-7-8-9-10 on
plan of Lot 6616, thence to points 10-11-1-2-3 on plan of Lot 6564, thence to point 1 on plan of Lot 6565,
thence to points 2-3-4-5 on plan of Lot 6568, thence to points 15-16-1-2 on plan of Lot 6574, thence to points
5-6 on plan of Lot 6574, thence to points 18-1-2 on plan of Lot 6575, thence to points 4-5-6-7-8-9 on plan of
Lot 6579, thence to points 9-1 on plan of Lot 6588, thence to points 2-3-4-5-6 on plan of Lot 6591, thence to
points 8-9-10 on plan of Lot 6597, thence to point 3 on plan of Lot 6598, thence to points 7-8 on plan of Lot
6599, thence to points 7-8-9-10 on plan of Lot 6600, thence to points 6-7 on plan of Lot 6049, thence to point
8 on plan of Lot 6042, thence to points 2-3-4-5-6-7-8 on plan of Lot 6016, thence going South Along Paloyon
Creek up to the boundary of Nabua-Iriga City. "
